mapper.select: select * from delivery_option WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: insert into delivery_option (name) values (#{deliveryOption.name}) on conflict (name) do update set deleted_at = null, name = EXCLUDED.name;
mapper.update: update delivery_option set name = #{deliveryOption.name} where delivery_optn_id = #{deliveryOption.deliveryOptnId}
update delivery_option set deleted_at = now() where delivery_optn_id = #{deliveryOptionId}
